jobs.description: Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones) Start Date: ASAP Languages: English Team: Engineering About the Role Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand. We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents. This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation. This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring. What You'll Do Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case. Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods. Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation. Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts. Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields. Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards. What We're Looking For Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems. Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content. Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility. An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate. High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes. Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap. Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones. Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production. jobs.description: About us At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. The role Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer. You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients. You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job. Key responsibilities Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list. Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them. Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs. Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses. Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path. Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended. Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client. Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse. Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards. Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need. Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Filiz est une startup SaaS de 30 personnes qui digitalise aujourd'hui les contrats d'apprentissage en France et construit son deuxième produit : un ERP nouvelle génération pour transformer la façon dont les établissements d'enseignement supérieur opèrent au quotidien. Depuis 2025, Filiz est accompagnée par Hexa, le startup studio français derrière des succès de licornes comme Spendesk, Aircall et Front. Nous attaquons un marché immense, encore largement à réinventer. Le premier produit est en production, les clients sont là. Maintenant, nous entrons dans une nouvelle phase : construire un produit ambitieux, sortir de France et bâtir la référence européenne des outils pour l'enseignement supérieur. Nous cherchons un(e) Senior Software Engineer capable de prendre l'ownership d'un produit, d'une architecture et d'un domaine technique, tout en restant profondément hands-on. Le poste n'a pas de management hiérarchique : ton impact passe par le code, les choix d'architecture et la montée en compétence de l'équipe. Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre. Ce que tu vas faire chez nous Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production. Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler. PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité. Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes. Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs. Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi. Ce qui t'attend techniquement Stack : TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour Profil recherché 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs. Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps. Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run. Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework. Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion. Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique. Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite. Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs. Processus de recrutement Echange RH Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs Prise de référence et offre Conditions Salaire : 50-65 k€ selon expérience Télétravail : full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie) Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitno

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running. Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. Supported by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software. WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS Als Forward Deployed Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass remberg bei unseren Kunden zum Herzstück der Instandhaltung wird. Du arbeitest hands-on zwischen Prospects, Kunden, Product und Engineering. Du verbindest remberg mit SAP und anderen ERP-Systemen, bringst Sensor- und Maschinendaten auf die Plattform und gibst der remberg KI den Kontext, den sie braucht, um in der Industrie echten Mehrwert zu liefern. Du baust, was Kund:innen brauchen, bringst es schnell live und lässt deine Learnings direkt ins Produkt einfließen. Als erster FDE bei remberg gestaltest du die Rolle von Grund auf und baust die ersten Playbooks. Du berichtest direkt an Julian Borg, unseren Co-Founder und CPO, und arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Go-to-Market sowie Product und Engineering zusammen. Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Office in München und bist im Schnitt ein paar Tage im Monat bei Kunden vor Ort. THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE SAP/ERP-Integration: Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen remberg und SAP (z. B. SAP PM/MM, S/4HANA, ECC) oder anderen ERP-Systemen. Dabei begleitest du sie vom technischen Scoping über das Data Mapping bis zum stabilen Betrieb nach dem Go-live. Kundenkommunikation: Für Instandhaltung, Operations und IT bist du die technische Ansprechperson, vor Ort und remote. Du übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass alle mitkommen. Bei Kundencalls und Sales Deals in der späten Phase bist du dabei, schätzt Machbarkeit und Aufwand ein und beantwortest IT- und Security-Fragen. B. über IoT-Plattformen, OPC UA, MQTT oder Kunden-APIs) an remberg an und ermöglichst so zustandsbasierte Instandhaltung und automatisch ausgelöste Aufträge. AI Context Engineering: Du bereitest Kundendaten, Dokumente und Instandhaltungswissen so auf, dass die remberg KI präzise und verlässliche Antworten liefert. Gemeinsam mit Kunden prüfst du die Ergebnisse und verbesserst den Kontext Schritt für Schritt. Product-Feedback-Loop: Wenn mehrere Kunden vor derselben Herausforderung stehen, machst du mit Product und Engineering aus der Einzellösung ein Feature für alle. Du baust wiederverwendbare Integrationspakete und schreibst Playbooks, mit denen AEs und CSMs Standardfragen selbst beantworten können. HOW YOU'LL GROW WITH US Erfahrung: 3+ Jahre in Software Engineering, Solutions oder Integration Engineering, technischer Beratung, Product Management oder ähnlichen Rollen, idealerweise im B2B-Software-, Industrie- oder Fertigungsumfeld. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst sicher mit Stakeholdern vom Shopfloor über die IT bis zum Management, gehst Probleme strukturiert an und willst Dinge shippen. Integrations-Know-how: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit APIs (REST, OData), Data Mapping und Enterprise-Systemen. Erfahrung mit SAP oder anderen ERP-Systemen ist ein großes Plus. Industriedaten & IoT: Du kennst dich mit Sensordaten, IoT-Plattformen oder Industrieprotokollen (z. B. OPC UA, MQTT) aus oder hast richtig Lust, dich einzuarbeiten. Engineering Skills: Solide Programmierkenntnisse (z. B. jobs.title: Workplace and People Operations Manager
jobs.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. mission As Workplace & People Operations Manager at telli, you own the environment our team does its best work in. You're responsible for keeping our Berlin office running smoothly day to day: workplace processes, people ops, internal events, and the culture initiatives that make telli feel like telli. what you'll do: run our Berlin office: supplies, equipment, and making sure we stay productive and well-organized drive culture initiatives that keep the team connected as we grow own the employee lifecycle, from onboarding (so new joiners have desk, hardware, and access ready before they walk in) to offboarding build automations around workplace and people ops (ordering, inventory, requests) with AI and no-code tools jump in wherever help is needed, because no two weeks look the same what makes you a great fit: you have a few years of experience in workplace, office, or people operations, ideally at a startup you're hands-on and happy to do the unglamorous work that makes everything else possible you're organized, reliable, and notice the details others miss you build processes that scale instead of solving the same problem twice you're curious about tools and automation and pick up new things fast you take ownership and don't wait for detailed instructions you communicate well in both English and German you're a host at heart and love creating great experiences for others you may not be a great fit if: you only want to do high-level "strategic" work juggling multiple things at once stresses you out you want to work fully remote, since this role lives in the office you'd rather watch than roll up your sleeves Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job. You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath. Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck. Make integration a capability, not a project: every client brings their own upstream systems, and today each connection is built by hand. Build the layer those systems plug into, so what makes a client different arrives as context the agents read, never as custom code. One more client must never mean one more integration project. Reproducibility and control A tax advisor must get the same result twice, and an auditor must be able to trace it. Probabilistic where there is variance, deterministic where there are numbers. Build the control layer so that a certified professional sees within seconds what an agent did (version, source, decision) and can sign off on it. Build evaluation on decades of audited, completed work. Team and scale Make the architecture calls: design, stack, build or buy for the layer. Nobody has decided it for you, and nobody will overrule it by committee. Hire and lead the engineering team. The budget for your first engineers is approved. You start hiring in your first quarter. Make every acquired firm land on the same base, so technology scales with every acquisition. And stay in the code: you commit and you review. Questions you'll answer Where exactly does probabilistic end and deterministic begin? How does a system learn from closed cases without losing its reproducibility? A new client arrives with their own systems. What may change in the system, and what may not? What success looks like 6 months: Architecture decided. jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients. What you will need Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications. The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why. Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one. The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy. A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player. Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel. Fluent English. Nice-to-have Certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, or CPTS. A proven bug bounty track record or other real world offensive security experience. Experience working with SMEs or mid market customers on security topics. What we offer A meaningful mission, protecting organisations across Europe from real world cyber threats. Work with top tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds. A remote friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats, for example in Spain, Portugal, or Italy. Thursday socials to stay connected. A generous time off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days. We combine cutting edge technology with hands on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr. Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following. Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage. Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review. Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind. jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metr

Wir sind Akademis, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsberatung. Wir helfen Familien, das passende Internat im Ausland für ihr Kind zu finden, und begleiten sie bei den nächsten Schritten. Dabei baust du persönliche Kontakte und eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf. Eigene Projekte gestalten und umsetzen: Du übernimmst Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, bringst Ideen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit uns Abläufe. Du denkst mit und packst an: Du erkennst, wo dein Beitrag gebraucht wird, unterstützt dein Team und möchtest unser kleines Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten. Eigene Ideen bringst du ein und hilfst dabei, sie umzusetzen. Du gehst neue Herausforderungen offen an: Du arbeitest dich engagiert in neue Themen ein, stellst gezielte Fragen und entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten weiter. Du verbindest Sorgfalt mit Tempo: Du arbeitest konzentriert und zügig, setzt Prioritäten und behältst parallele Anliegen im Blick. Unterlagen, Daten und Termine prüfst du gewissenhaft auf Richtigkeit und Vollständigkeit. Du hältst Absprachen nachvollziehbar fest und kontrollierst deine Ergebnisse, bevor du sie weitergibst. Du nimmst die Wünsche und Sorgen von Eltern und Jugendlichen ernst und kommunizierst auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen herzlich, klar und professionell. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights. Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi. About the Role We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market. In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more. What You’ll Do Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate: Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about Create engaging ways to show our product Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants needs to create our own path What You’ll Need You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry: Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality Previous POS/ Hospitality tech sales is a strong plus You are comfortable working in English If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. jobs.description: Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career? At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit. We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle. Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you. We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Wednesday 18th November , giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu. You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients. Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home. Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters. Opportunities Available We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry. Pharmacy Assistant An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required. You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently. We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity. No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team. You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety. Pharmacy Dispenser For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment. You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team. You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes. Accuracy Checking Dispenser We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy. jobs.title: Anaesthetic (Pain) Consultant
jobs.description: At Montu UK, we are passionate about improving the lives of patients who have often exhausted conventional treatment options. Through our Alternaleaf clinic, we are helping people living with chronic and debilitating conditions access treatments that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life. We are looking for Consultant Anaesthetists who are interested in exploring the growing field of medical cannabis and developing their expertise in chronic pain management. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing healthcare organisation, working alongside a multidisciplinary team of experienced clinicians who share a passion for improving patient outcomes. With a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management and comprehensive specialist training, we are keen to hear from consultants who are open to exploring new approaches to patient care and want to make a meaningful difference in an evolving area of medicine. Previous chronic pain experience is not essential. What matters is a genuine interest in learning, an open-minded approach to alternative treatment options and a commitment to delivering excellent patient care. What is the job? As a Consultant Anaesthetist at Montu, the role focuses on assessing and supporting patients living with chronic pain who may have exhausted conventional treatment options. Working within our Alternaleaf clinic, consultants play a central role in determining the suitability of cannabis-based prescription medicines (CBPMs), developing individualised treatment plans and supporting patients throughout their treatment journey. The position offers the opportunity to build on existing expertise in analgesic pharmacology, pain management and opioid stewardship while developing specialist knowledge in an evolving area of medicine. Our multidisciplinary approach brings together consultants, nurses, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals, allowing consultants to focus on clinical assessment, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient care. Sponsored Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management As part of our commitment to clinical development, Montu is offering a fully funded Postgraduate Diploma in Pain Management through the University of South Wales , delivered fully online in partnership with Learna. The programme provides an opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in chronic pain management while continuing to gain practical clinical experience within our multidisciplinary team. About the diploma A 12-month, part-time postgraduate diploma with all teaching and assessment completed online. Focuses on interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary pain management, assessment and service provision. Full course fees funded by Montu UK. Two hours of protected, paid study time each week. Further information about the programme is available through the University of South Wales . Eligibility A minimum working commitment of 24 hours per week with Montu. Two of those hours each week are allocated as protected, paid study time. Continued employment with Montu at a minimum of 24 hours per week for the duration of the diploma. What will you be doing? Providing high-quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment for chronic pain and other qualifying conditions. Conducting patient consultations, including clinical assessments, prescribing decisions and ongoing patient management. Applying anaesthetic expertise in analgesic pharmacology, drug interactions and opioid stewardship to support safe prescribing. Reviewing patient progress and treatment effectiveness, making adjustments where clinically appropriate. Engaging in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence-based practice. Contributing to clinical governance and maintaining robust patient care standards. Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Montu UK’s mission is to make high-quality, plant-based therapies easier to access, while setting new standards in safety, clinical excellence and patient experience so that many more people can benefit from personalised treatment options. As Product Manager, you will work across business functions to specify and deliver software solutions which sustain Montu UK's rapid growth, while maintaining an unswerving focus on the quality of our patient-care. You will work across every aspect of the business, from patient engagement to dispensing and dispatch. You will interact with stakeholders at every level, collating their insights and expertise to generate a roadmap which drives the business forward. Analytical Skills: Analytical mindset with the ability to use data and metrics to drive decisions and solve complex problems. Able to provide examples of evidence-led product development. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metr

jobs.description: Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results. Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta. This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel. Your team You will join the Supply team, which owns Vibe's inventory: the publishers we partner with, the deals we run, and the catalog of apps, channels and shows our advertisers care about. Shows are the reason people turn on their TV. Advertisers don't just want impressions: they want to show up next to the right shows, live sports and premium channels. Supply brings that content to Vibe through direct publisher partnerships, curated deals and sponsorships. It makes it easy to find, understand and buy, through real-time bidding, or any technology the publisher uses. Premium publishers care as much about which ads run on their shows as about who buys them, and great creatives are what earn us access. The team brings together partnerships, operations, and product. You will work closely with the DSP team, which runs the bidding infrastructure, and the Performance team, which decides how to value each opportunity, as well as with publisher partners directly. Your mission As a Senior Software Engineer on Supply, you will build the systems that let Vibe grow, operate, and trust its inventory. You will turn publisher partnerships into live, healthy supply, and give the business and our partners the tools to manage it at scale. What you will do Publisher integrations Build and improve publisher integrations end-to-end, from onboarding a new partner to supporting new ad formats and sponsorship offers. Implement measurement requirements with publishers and the DSP team (e.g. UID2, publisher IDs) so the bidder sees richer inventory. Own integration health: detect broken or degraded supply before it costs us spend. Deals & catalog Build the services behind deal setup, catalog management, and price configuration, in partnership with DSP on the deal API. Automate the routine work of the Supply team (new deals, stale-supply cleanup, troubleshooting) so it scales with the number of partners, and with Vibe. Enrich the catalog with content data (shows, genres, live events, channels) so advertisers can find what they are looking for, and even enjoy looking for it. Supply tooling & publisher platform Build real-time monitoring, alerting, and analytics on supply volume, quality, and spend. Build publisher-facing features: reporting, insights, and self-serve catalog tools. What we're looking for 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and operating backend systems in production. Systems: keep CRM and revenue data reliable as we add products, run commission plans people trust, and replace manual work with automations and AI agents. Als leidinggevende sta je dicht bij je team, geef je richting en neem je mensen met positieve energie mee. jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Fintech
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You will own the agents, skills and standards that let a tribe of product builders move quickly on payments without the architecture fragmenting. Hotels take payments across regions and through providers that each behave differently, and Payment Interfaces exists to give customers one coherent payment experience on top of several PSPs. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.</p> <p>You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.</p> <p>The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. When integrations drift apart, builders slow down and quality suffers. This role exists to keep them coherent by encoding what good looks like into tools and agents, so every builder meets the standard by default.</p> <h4><strong>What you would do</strong>&nbsp;</h4> <ul> <li>Own the tribe’s engineering agents, skills and context, and encode architectural standards, review logic and quality gates into them so the standard is met by default.</li> <li>Build an AI first responder for customer tickets about payment issues, with clear rules for when it answers and when it hands over to a person.</li> <li>Stay hands-on for the hardest technical problems: migrations, system-wide refactors and long-lived architecture decisions across PSP integrations.</li> <li>Keep Payment Interfaces integrations coherent as PSPs and regional requirements change, collaborating with builders who own their own work.</li> <li>Coach builders and fix off-standard outcomes at the cause, so the lesson sticks.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 4:</strong> in this role, that means you build the AI systems the tribe works in, not only use them. You design the agents, skills and evaluations that builders rely on every day, make the engineering decisions about how they behave, and set the rules for when an AI answer can stand and when a person must step in.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to “<a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/external/YWI5ZGUyMGQ3MjU2NGRmNjlkZGEyYTg2NTVmZGE0OTU">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a>” on Confluence.</em></p> <h4><strong>What you would bring</strong>&

jobs.title: hbo-stage Bedrijfskunde: Digitalisering en Procesoptimalisatie van communicatie
jobs.description: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die enthousiaste hbo-student die het leuk vindt om organisatievraagstukken te onderzoeken en processen te verbeteren? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) wil het gebruik van papieren post verminderen en de mogelijkheden voor digitale communicatie verder uitbreiden. Dit geldt zowel voor de communicatie met bedrijven als met personen. Tijdens deze stage richt je je specifiek op de communicatie met individuele onderzoekspersonen. Op dit moment benadert het CBS onderzoekspersonen in eerste instantie vrijwel altijd via een brief op het huisadres. Digitale communicatie, bijvoorbeeld via e-mail, biedt kansen om dit proces efficiënter, flexibeler en toekomstbestendiger in te richten. Er lopen binnen het CBS al verschillende initiatieven om meer gebruik te maken van e-mailadressen, maar er zijn ook nog belangrijke vraagstukken die onderzocht moeten worden. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de volgende vragen: Hoe kan het CBS op een effectieve manier e-mailadressen van onderzoekspersonen verzamelen en beheren? Welke juridische en privacyvoorwaarden gelden voor het opbouwen en gebruiken van een e-maildatabase? Welke technische aanpassingen en voorzieningen zijn nodig om digitale communicatie mogelijk te maken? Hoe moeten de bestaande werkprocessen worden aangepast om digitale communicatie goed te ondersteunen? Hoe kunnen we ervoor zorgen dat onderzoekspersonen op een toegankelijke en betrouwbare manier digitaal benaderd worden? Samen met het Waarneeminnovatie Team en collega's van de afdeling Dataverzameling ga je dit vraagstuk onderzoeken. Je brengt de huidige situatie in kaart, onderzoekt mogelijkheden voor verbetering en werkt toe naar concrete aanbevelingen voor het CBS. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Heerlen Je gaat aan de slag in het Team Waarneeminnovatie. Dit team valt binnen de afdeling Dataverzameling. We zijn een jong, divers en vooral enthousiast team dat als doel heeft de waarneming van het CBS te vernieuwen en te verbeteren.  Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo-opleiding Bedrijfskunde of een soortgelijke opleiding. Je hebt interesse in procesoptimalisatie, digitalisering en organisatieverandering. Je bent nieuwsgierig, onderzoekend en neemt graag initiatief. Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende betrokkenen binnen een organisatie in gesprek te gaan. Je hebt een proactieve, positieve en assertieve houding en denkt in oplossingen, staat open voor feedback en gaat uitdagingen met enthousiasme aan. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samen met ervaren vakmensen bestaande processen analyseert en verbeterkansen herkent; zelfstandig een praktijkgericht onderzoek of experiment opzet; aan de slag gaat met het in kaart brengen van verschillende organisatorische, juridische en technische belangen en randvoorwaarden rondom digitale communicatie; leert om onderzoeksresultaten te vertalen naar concrete, onderbouwde en uitvoerbare aanbevelingen voor het CBS. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. That starts with keeping their data safe. As AI makes attackers faster, we’re seeing more critical zero-day vulnerabilities than ever, and we need to stay ahead of them. That’s where you come in. As our  Security Engineer , you’ll own how 700 colleagues get secure access to our systems, and you’ll help defend bunq against attacks as they happen. You’ll design and build security processes that AI can’t run on its own, and automate everything that it can. Take Ownership 🚀 You’ll keep bunq secure, from access control to incident response. Here’s how you’ll do it: Own access control governance in Okta Identity Governance, automating how access is granted, revoked and reviewed, so every employee and contractor has the right access from day one. Investigate and triage security incidents and vulnerability findings, decide whether they’re malicious, and escalate or fix them fast. Drive the replacement of our security monitoring system with an AI-based platform that detects and stops threats automatically, and build automations so the team can focus on real security issues. You’ve worked hands-on as a security engineer, investigating and triaging security incidents. You write code to automate security work, not just to run scripts. You’ve worked with identity governance and know how to build secure login and access solutions. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare. Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be. We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉 Your role You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems. This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan. What you will be doing, among others: Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps. Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through. Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies. Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed. Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership. Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations. Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. jobs.description: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen. Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou! Wat bieden wij jou? You will take technical ownership at the intersection of Systems Engineering, R&D, Production and Industrialization. Rather than leading a team from a disciplinary perspective, you will act as a senior technical expert and sparring partner , helping establish robust processes, solve complex system-level issues and continuously improve the maturity of our products and production environment. The role offers a high degree of ownership in an environment where structures and processes are still evolving and where your expertise can have a direct impact on how we industrialize our systems. What is your Day to Day Mission: Drive the industrialization of complex unmanned systems from prototype and development stages toward stable serial production. Take technical ownership of system-level topics throughout the industrialization lifecycle . Analyze and resolve complex technical issues arising during production, integration, testing and operation. Identify whether technical issues originate from product design, system integration, manufacturing processes or individual components and drive them toward sustainable resolution. Define and continuously improve technical processes, standards and methodologies for industrialization and system integration. Work closely with Systems Engineering, R&D, Production, Quality, Testing and Supply Chain to ensure product and production readiness. Translate lessons learned from production and field feedback into concrete technical improvements. Support root cause analysis and structured problem solving for recurring or critical system-level issues. Ensure that system requirements, interfaces and technical dependencies are understood and adequately reflected in the production environment. Act as a senior technical sparring partner for engineers and stakeholders across different disciplines. Mentor colleagues through your technical expertise and help establish best practices without formal disciplinary leadership responsibility. Contribute to building scalable structures as products and production volumes continue to grow. What you bring to the team: A degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a comparable technical field. Several years of professional experience in Systems Engineering, Industrialization, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering or a comparable technical role. Strong experience working with complex multidisciplinary products , ideally involving hardware, electronics, embedded software and mechanical systems. Proven experience supporting products during the transition from prototype or development into serial production . Strong understanding of system architecture, interfaces, requirements and verification principles. Practical experience with structured problem-solving and root-cause-analysis methods, for example 8D, FMEA, Ishikawa or 5-Why . Ability to identify dependencies across engineering disciplines and translate complex technical problems into actionable solutions. Experience working closely with production and engineering teams in a fast-moving development environment. A pragmatic and hands-on mindset with a strong sense of technical ownership . Confidence in challenging existing approaches and establishing new technical standards and processes. Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical decisions across teams without formal leadership authority . Fluent English skills; German is an advantage. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Quantum-Sys

jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably. Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design. Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later. Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs. Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate. How we work: AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production. Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence. Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital. Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints. Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog. Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage. What we’re looking for: Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team. Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count. Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes. Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code. Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required. Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team. Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval

jobs.title: AI-First Adoption Lead (m/w/d) KI- Einführung und Prozessautomatisierung
jobs.description: Jobbeschreibung Wer wir sind benuta ist eine Designmarke für Wohnräume: eigene Kollektionen, Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa und über 150 Menschen in der Gruppe, vom Design über E-Commerce bis zur eigenen Logistik. Wir bauen unsere Multibrand-Strategie aus und entwickeln neben benuta weitere Marken. Worum es geht benuta arbeitet AI-first. Nicht als Projekt, sondern als Betriebsmodell. Jede Marke, jedes Team und jeder Prozess läuft auf derselben Grundlage: benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet. Nexus Cortex: Wissen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen. Eine Wahrheit, an einem Ort. Nexus Flow: jede Aufgabe und jeder Ablauf, nachvollziehbar und automatisierbar. Nexus Core: Konten, Zugänge und Ablage als Fundament. Die Architektur steht, KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen laufen. Jetzt geht es um Adoption: Jedes Team arbeitet vollständig in benuta Nexus, und aus Prozessen werden durchgängige, KI-gestützte Workflows. Warum wir das machen Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist. Deine Aufgaben Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows. benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden. Befähigen: Du schulst Teams und Führungskräfte, entwickelst kurze, wirksame Formate und machst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen vom ersten Tag an arbeitsfähig. Anforderungen schärfen: Du übersetzt den Bedarf der Teams in vollständige Anforderungen mit Problem, Ablauf, Nutzen und Abnahmekriterium und bringst sie in die Weiterentwicklung von benuta Nexus ein. KI-Werkzeuge verantworten: Du führst unsere KI-gestützten Lösungen, etwa im Kundenservice und im Bewertungsmanagement, und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Ergebnisse dort ankommen, wo daraus Verbesserungen werden. Transparenz schaffen: Du misst Nutzung und Wirkung, analysierst, wo es hakt, und berichtest ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht. Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen. Stellenanforderungen Das bringst du mit Umgesetzte KI-Projekte: Du hast KI in einem Unternehmen produktiv eingeführt, zum Beispiel mit KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen oder KI-gestützten Abläufen, und kannst den Nutzen in Zahlen belegen. Prozess- und Workflow-Denken: Du denkst in Abläufen über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und erkennst, wo Automatisierung den größten Hebel hat. Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Architektur funktioniert, wie Systeme ineinandergreifen und wie Unternehmensprozesse in einer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft orchestriert werden. Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten und Kennzahlen, ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse und berichtest sachlich, auch wenn ein Ergebnis hinter dem Plan bleibt. Leadership: Du gehst voran, schaffst Klarheit, setzt Ziele, lebst Regeln konsequent vor und nimmst die Menschen auf den Weg mit.
