jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Data, Controlling & KPI-Reporting
jobs.description: Einarbeitung (Monat 1–2): Du lernst unsere Datenquellen, KPIs und bestehenden Auswertungen kennen und erstellst die Reports zunächst gemeinsam mit unserem Team, dann zunehmend selbstständig. Deine Aufgaben Tägliches KPI-Reporting: Du stellst dem Head of KAM jeden Tag alle benötigten Auswertungen bereit: aktuell, korrekt und auf den Punkt. Kennzahlen im Blick: Du verfolgst die wichtigsten KPIs und vergleichst sie mit den Vorwochen und dem Durchschnitt. Proaktive Abweichungsanalyse: Weichen Zahlen ab, meldest Du das von Dir aus und ordnest ein, was dahintersteckt. Ursachen finden, Handlungsbedarf erkennen: Du analysierst die Gründe und zeigst auf, bei welchen Teammitgliedern Unterstützung oder Handlungsbedarf besteht. Reports weiterentwickeln & automatisieren: Du optimierst bestehende Auswertungen und automatisierst wiederkehrende Reports, wo es sinnvoll ist. Ad-hoc-Analysen: Du übernimmst kurzfristige Analysen für das Key Account Management. Das bringst du mit Du bist eingeschriebener Student , z. B. in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsmathematik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Fach. Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen und gehst sicher mit MS Excel oder Google Sheets um. Plus, aber kein Muss: Erste Erfahrung mit SQL, BI-Tools wie Power BI oder Tableau oder im Controlling. Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert , auch wenn es mal schnell gehen muss. Du kommunizierst klar und traust Dich, Auffälligkeiten direkt anzusprechen , auch gegenüber Führungskräften. Du kannst 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten, verteilt auf alle Wochentage (Mo–Fr), da das Reporting täglich anfällt. Du arbeitest vor Ort in unserem Büro in Berlin Mitte. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch (mindestens C1) , da Du täglich Auswertungen mit dem Head of KAM besprichst und Auffälligkeiten klar kommunizierst. C2 ist ein Plus. Benefits Echte Verantwortung – Du hast einen direkten Draht zum Head of Key Account Management, und Deine Analysen zählen jeden Tag. Praxiswissen für Studium und Karriere – Du sammelst Erfahrung in Controlling, KPI-Reporting und Datenanalyse. Flexible Zeiteinteilung – Innerhalb des Tages stimmst Du Deine Arbeitszeiten auf Deine Vorlesungen ab. In der Prüfungsphase finden wir gemeinsam eine Lösung. Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte – Zentral gelegen, mit bester Anbindung und freundlicher Atmosphäre. Top Equipment – Laptop, Bildschirm, Headset – alles für Deinen Erfolg. Innovative Tools – Slack, Zoom & CRM-Systeme, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient machen. Events & Teambuilding – Ob Fußball, Volleyball oder After-Work: Bei uns kommt der Spaß nicht zu kurz. Snacks & Drinks – Gratis Kaffee, Getränke, Obst und individuelle REWE-Snacks auf Knopfdruck. FRIYAY-Mood – Jeden Freitag gemeinsamer Ausklang mit Pizza und Bier. jobs.title: Elektroplaner Smart Home als Content Creator (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Remote · 4-Tage-Woche möglich · 50.000–80.000 € p. a. (Vollzeit) „Smart Home oder konventionell?“ Die Frage landet immer bei dir, weil du dich sehr gut auskennst und auch gut erklären kannst? Dann komm zu uns und mach genau das zu deinem Job! JETPLAN entwickelt die Zukunft der Elektroplanung – für Elektrohandwerk, Planer und Bauwirtschaft. Wir suchen eine Person, die echte Planungspraxis aus dem Wohnbau mitbringt und daraus Videos, Musterplanungen und How-tos für YouTube und Social Media macht. Du bist das Gesicht, das zeigt, wie moderne und zunehmend KI-gestützte Elektroplanung mit JETPLAN funktioniert. Dein Fachwissen ist dabei der Kern: Nur wer selbst plant, kann komplexe Themen so erklären, dass Elektriker und Bauherren wirklich etwas davon haben. Deine Aufgaben Du produzierst How-to-Videos, Tutorials und Kurzformate für YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram & Co. Dabei erklärst du, wie typische Kundenwünsche in JETPLAN planerisch dargestellt werden. Du erstellst normkonforme Musterplanungen für typische Wohnbauprojekte – vom Einfamilienhaus bis zur Wohnung, konventionell und Smart Home. Du zeigst Systeme wie KNX, Loxone und DALI im Planungsalltag: Wann passt was, worauf kommt es an? Du entwickelst Themen- und Formatideen mit und greifst Fragen aus der Community auf. Mit deiner Planungserfahrung bringst du wertvolle Impulse in die Produktentwicklung ein. Dein Publikum: Elektriker, Planer und planungsinteressierte Bauherren. Wohin die Rolle wachsen kann Im Kern geht es ums Planen, Erklären und Beraten vor der Kamera. Wenn du Lust und Erfahrung mitbringst, kann die Rolle deutlich strategischer werden: Du gestaltest die Content-Ausrichtung mit – welche Zielgruppen, welche Themen, wo Longform, wo Shortform –, spielst Inhalte gezielt über YouTube, Suche und Social Ads aus und wertest aus, welche Inhalte wirklich Anfragen bringen. Wie weit das geht, entscheiden wir gemeinsam – je nachdem, was du mitbringst. Das bringst du mit Du musst nicht aus einem Planungsbüro kommen: Quereinsteiger mit elektrotechnischer Ausbildung sind herzlich willkommen, vor allem aus dem Elektrohandwerk. Das ist uns wichtig Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung von Elektroinstallationen, konventionell und Smart Home, mit Schwerpunkt Wohnbau (komplexe Anlagen, Zweckbau oder Industrie musst du nicht beherrschen) Sichere Kenntnisse gängiger Systeme wie KNX, Loxone, DALI etc. Du kannst gut beraten und Zusammenhänge einfach erklären Du stehst gern vor der Kamera, nimmst dich ohne Scheu beim Planen auf und hast eine natürliche Präsenz Echte Freude an Elektroplanung und Smart Home Fließendes Deutsch (zwingend) Schön, aber kein Muss Kenntnisse in der Lichtplanung Gute Englischkenntnisse Erfahrung mit Videoaufnahme und Videoschnitt Eigene Kanäle oder erste Content-Erfahrung auf YouTube oder Social Media Erfahrung mit Content-Strategie, SEO oder Performance-Marketing Das bieten wir 100 % remote: Du arbeitest von dort, wo du am besten planst und aufnimmst. 4-Tage-Woche möglich: Mehr Zeit für dich – bei gleichem Anspruch an deine Arbeit. Gehalt: 50.000–80.000 € brutto pro Jahr bei 100 %, je nach Qualifikation Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Formate und Inhalte von Anfang an mit – und wenn du willst, auch die gesamte Content-Ausrichtung. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründerteam, Entscheidungen fallen schnell – ohne Politik, allein danach, was unseren Kunden wirklich hilft. KI-Planung von Anfang an: Du arbeitest mit den neuesten Planungswerkzeugen und prägst, wie sie im Alltag funktionieren. Bewirb dich – gern mit Video Du brennst für Elektroplanung? Wir freuen uns auf dich! Nutze den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite, um uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Gehaltsvorstellung und deinen frühesten Starttermin zu senden. Statt eines Anschreibens freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Video (freiwillig, 1–3 Minuten, Handy reicht): Stell dich vor und erklär uns ein Smart-Home-Thema deiner Wahl – zum Beispiel, wann du KNX und wann Loxone empfiehlst. Falls vorhanden, verlinke gern

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: <h3>About the Position</h3> <p>Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you are paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.</p> <p>As a Software Engineering intern, you'll learn how we use OCaml (our primary development language) in our day-to-day work, and gain exposure to the libraries and tools that are foundational to our internal systems. Some teams also use Python, so depending on the project, you might do some work with Python as well.</p> <p>During the internship, you'll be closely mentored by full-time software engineers. Mentors design intern projects based on their team's current needs and are heavily invested in helping interns build maintainable, high-quality software that is intended to reach production. The projects you will work on are as varied and diverse as those full-timers work on, covering a wide range of problems, from high-performance trading systems to programming language design and everything in between.</p> <p>If you’d like to learn more, you can read about our <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/preparing-for-a-software-engineering-interview/">interview</a> and<a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/project-pairing/#fn:1"> team placement</a> processes and get a sense of what our <a href="https://blog.janestreet.com/tag/internship/">most recent intern projects</a> looked like! You can also learn more about Jane Street’s internship program <a href="https://www.janestreet.com/join-jane-street/internships/">here</a>.</p> <h3>About You</h3> <p>If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, & a fast-growing global community. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair. As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions. About the Role The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on. 1. Client projects Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs. Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention. Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence. Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on. Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live. 2. jobs.title: Responsable comptable adjoint(e)
jobs.description: Vous aimez la comptabilité dans toute sa dimension opérationnelle ? Vous appréciez autant la technicité des travaux de clôture que l'analyse des résultats et la fiabilisation des données financières ? Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Comptable Adjoint(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe et accompagner le suivi comptable et financier de notre entreprise et de ses filiales françaises. Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Administrative et financière, vous occupez un rôle polyvalent et central, associant production comptable, révision des comptes, reporting financier et suivi fiscal. Vous intervenez concrètement dans les opérations du quotidien tout en contribuant aux travaux financiers et aux remontées d'informations destinées au Groupe. Vos missions Assurer la gestion comptable au quotidien Réaliser les opérations courantes de comptabilité générale et fournisseurs. Assurer ponctuellement la saisie et l'enregistrement des factures fournisseurs. Effectuer le rapprochement des factures avec les commandes et les réceptions. Contrôler les imputations comptables et analytiques. Participer au suivi et à la justification des comptes. 2. Participer aux clôtures et à la révision des comptes Préparer et contribuer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles et annuelles. Participer à l'élaboration du bilan et du compte de résultat. Réaliser les travaux de révision : justification des comptes, contrôle des écritures, rapprochements et régularisations. Veiller à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données comptables. 3. Contribuer au reporting et à la consolidation Participer aux travaux de consolidation des comptes du Groupe. Collecter, contrôler et fiabiliser les données financières des différentes entités. Élaborer les reportings périodiques et les tableaux de bord destinés au Responsable Administratif. Participer à l'analyse des résultats et à la préparation des données financières présentées au Groupe. 4. Apporter votre soutien au contrôle de gestion Participer à la préparation et à l'analyse des résultats. Contribuer au suivi des données analytiques et à l'analyse des écarts entre le réalisé et les prévisions. Participer à la fiabilisation des indicateurs de performance. 5. Participer au suivi de la trésorerie et de la fiscalité Contribuer au suivi des flux et des positions de trésorerie des filiales françaises. Participer à l'élaboration des prévisions de trésorerie. Préparer, établir et contrôler les déclarations de TVA et autres déclarations fiscales. Veiller au respect des échéances et des obligations déclaratives. Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance, de type DCG, Licence professionnelle ou équivalent (Bac +3 minimum). Vous justifiez idéalement de plus de 5 années d'expérience minimum en comptabilité générale, acquises de préférence dans un environnement multi-sociétés ou au sein d'une PME structurée. Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes comptables, les opérations de clôture et de révision ainsi que les obligations fiscales courantes, notamment en matière de TVA. Une connaissance des processus de consolidation, du reporting financier et du suivi de trésorerie sera particulièrement appréciée. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, notamment Excel, et savez exploiter des données comptables pour en tirer des analyses fiables. Au-delà de votre parcours, nous recherchons une personne : Rigoureuse et organisée, attachée à la fiabilité de son travail. Autonome et impliquée, capable de prendre en charge ses missions de bout en bout. Polyvalente, appréciant autant les opérations comptables concrètes que les travaux d'analyse. Dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse. À l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et appréciant le travail en équipe. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun   a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯  Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés. Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux. Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de cinq ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Les travaux de la chaire incluent plusieurs doctorats et post-doctorats visant à faire progresser la connaissance du phénomène de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les aciers faiblement alliés et de la fragilisation associée, ainsi qu’à développer de nouvelles méthodologies de mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire, ou à améliorer les méthodologies existantes. Le post-doc proposé ici, financé par EDF, vise à déterminer l'effet de l'irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire, pour les matériaux suivis dans le cadre du programme de surveillance des effets de l'irradiation sur les matériaux des cuves REP d'EDF. Il est en effet important de savoir si de la fragilisation intergranulaire peut intervenir à forte fluence pour prévoir correctement l'évolution des propriétés de rupture. C'est donc une caractérisation qui vient en appui de l'interprétation des fragilisations mesurées dans le cadre du programme de surveillance. Le travail consistera à mesurer les états de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les états non irradié

jobs.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
jobs.description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. Work as one modelling team Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs. Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models. Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance. Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers. Stay close to the real world We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand. You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions. Who You Are You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use. You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers. You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information. You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations. Technical Requirements MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, or atmospheric sciences . Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
jobs.description: RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale. Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery Job Description   Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.     What you’ll be doing Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks. Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization. jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.description: Over Ockto Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten. De rol We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen. Signaleren en ontwikkelen van nieuwe zakelijke kansen en bijdragen aan de commerciële groei van Ockto. Begeleiden van gesprekken en trajecten met klanten, van de eerste behoefteanalyse tot het verder ontwikkelen van een mogelijke samenwerking. Samenwerken met interne teams om klantvraagstukken te vertalen naar haalbare oplossingen en commerciële resultaten. Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en mogelijkheden om Ockto's positie in de markt verder te versterken.  Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen om Ockto’s positie in de markt verder te versterken, waarbij je actief bijdraagt aan het benutten van sales mogelijkheden en het uitbouwen van klantrelaties. jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business. Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence. Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge. Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question. Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake. Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us. Requirements What You’ll Need Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field. 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously. Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does. Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQ

Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets. Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first. Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines. Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction. Solid understanding of manufacturing and quality metrics — throughput, cycle time, OEE, scrap and rework, first-pass yield — and of quality processes such as non-conformance handling, customer complaints and field returns, root cause analysis, and corrective actions. jobs.title: Campaign Analyst
jobs.description: Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen. Wat je gaat doen Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s. Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op. Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie. Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes. Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan? Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt. Dit ben jij Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak. Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré. Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken. Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter. Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen. Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem. 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden. jobs.title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs. What are you going to do? Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack. Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools. Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics. Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow. Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests. Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test. Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations. Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work. Qualifications Core Requirements: BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field. 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones. Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces. Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent. Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs. A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems. Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one. Bonus Points Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware. Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries. Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption. Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! You'll oversee the end-to-end procurement operations process, optimise inventory and supplier performance, and continuously improve the systems and processes that keep our production running smoothly.</p> <p>Working cross-functionally with Planning, Production, Finance, Culinary, and Operations, you'll play a key role in ensuring the right products are available at the right time, while driving operational excellence and supporting Factor's continued growth.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="text-align: left;">Lead and develop our Procurement Operations team, responsible for purchasing, supplier coordination, inventory management, and waste reduction.</li> <li style="text-align: left;">Own the end-to-end procurement operations process, ensuring ingredients and packaging are delivered On Time, In Full, and In Quality (OTIFQ) to support uninterrupted production.</li> <li>Drive inventory governance, ensuing product availability and operational efficiency while minimising waste and stock risk.</li> <li>Champion our zero-waste strategy through continuous optimisation of purchasing parameters, inventory controls, and forecasting inputs.</li> <li>Partner closely with Planning, Finance, Supply Chain, Culinary, and Production to optimize purchasing strategies and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.</li> <li>Monitor procurement KPIs, purchasing data, and system accuracy, using insights to identify trends, resolve discrepancies, and drive operational improvements.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and standardise procurement and inventory processes through data, technology, and continuous improvement initiatives.</li> <li>Develop reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility of procurement performance, inventory health, supplier performance, and key operational KPIs.</li> <li style="text-align: left;">Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making across Procurement Operations.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>At least 5-6 years of relevant work experience in a Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
jobs.description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK.&nbsp;This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions.&nbsp;This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.</li> <li>Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.</li> <li>Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>You are...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to rather than authority.</li> <li>Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>You have...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.</li> <li>Hands-on jobs.title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
jobs.description: Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen. Dit ga je doen Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie. Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt. Dit ben jij Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden. Dit bieden wij jou Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling. Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem. Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband). 27 vakantiedagen Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van! Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel. Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen. Dit breng jij mee Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen. Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen. Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau). Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier. Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden. Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek. jobs.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated. Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence. We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end. As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems. You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably. Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components. Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable. You look beyond data alone: you make processes clear, see opportunities for digitization and automation and use data to help departments. You translate data into concrete insights and actively contribute to the further professionalization of data-driven work within Royal Ingredients. What will you do? jobs.title: Senior Nuclear Theorist - Few-Body Physics (gn) @ Fusion Energy Venture, Munich
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture Snap Fusion develops a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy. We are a small team of physicists and engineers. The work is early, the questions are real, and the standard is high. Our findings feed into research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for Physics and quantum technologies. Some problems are too important not to solve. Your mission Lead the nuclear theory behind a new approach to fusion energy. At Snap Fusion, we are pursuing a bold mission: developing a fundamentally new approach to controlled fusion energy. Parts of our roadmap rest on questions of low-energy nuclear physics. Some of these have clear answers in the literature; others turn out, on close reading, to be less settled than they first appear. Knowing which is which matters to us, because it shapes what we build and what we test. We are therefore establishing an in-house nuclear theory effort, and we are looking for a senior few-body theorist to lead it. Your job will be to decide which of our questions current theory can actually answer, to answer those at a standard that would hold up to expert review, and to say plainly where the uncertainties lie. This is an unusual setting for a theorist, in a good way: the questions are concrete, the team is small, and your conclusions will be acted on. What you will do You will work directly with the founders as theory lead. Your responsibilities may include: • Leading theory projects from problem definition to a clear recommendation • Judging which questions current nuclear theory can answer, and with what uncertainty • Carrying out and supervising few-body scattering and reaction calculations • Setting the benchmarks and cross-checks against which results are accepted • Working with our computational physics lead on the numerical implementation of the methods you specify • Reviewing theoretical and experimental claims that bear on our roadmap • Building collaborations with academic groups, including for independent confirmation of key results • Helping the rest of the team understand the physics behind your conclusions Your assessments will directly inform Snap Fusion's technology roadmap. What we’re looking for You will probably hold a PhD in theoretical nuclear physics or a closely related field, with research experience beyond it. Ideal candidates will have strong experience in several of the following areas: Nuclear theory • Quantum scattering and reaction theory • Few-body or ab initio methods • Realistic nuclear interactions • Resonances, thresholds, and continuum physics • Low-energy charged-particle reactions • Fusion cross sections and astrophysical S-factors Scientific leadership. You should be comfortable: • Running a research program with milestones and honest go/no-go decisions • Saying that a question cannot be answered with current theory, when it cannot • Writing clearly for readers who are not few-body specialists • Reviewing other people's derivations, and having your own reviewed Like most few-body theorists, you will have done a good deal of numerical work, and that experience will be valuable here. But this is a physics role first: we have a computational physics lead, and implementation is a collaboration rather than the core of your job. Industry experience is not required. Bonus Points Experience with any of the following is a plus: • Light-nuclei reaction calculations • R-matrix or related continuum methods • Nuclear astrophysics • Benchmark comparisons between methods or codes • Close collaboration with experimentalists • Refereeing and reviewing • Teaching or mentoring Who thrives here? You may be a great fit if: • You like physics questions with practical consequences • You would rather establish a modest result firmly than a striking one loosely • You are comfortable saying “we don't know yet” and explaining why • You enjoy making difficult material clear to colleagues from other fie

jobs.title: Founding engineer, AI on CAD geometry (co-founder equity)
jobs.description: Founding engineer: AI that reads mechanical designs (Berlin / remote EU): LoopforgeLab enables machine and hardware makers make better design decisions by better we mean shorter design iterations, more sustainable products with less cost to manfuacture and own. We are building the Forge Engine is an agentic tool for manufacturing . Give it a BOM and a STEP file and it returns what the part costs to make and what the machine will cost to own over fifteen years, while there is still time to change the design. The lifecycle engine is built and runs on declared drivers. The agent already modifies geometry from natural-language instructions on our platform. The next piece is the reason we are hiring. We need geometry reasoning that holds up on real customer CAD: feature recognition from B-rep, tolerances read per feature rather than per part, similarity against parts we have already costed, and an evaluation setup that shows whether the agent is improving or only sounding more certain. Also we need to build integrations with different CAD/ER and PLM systems. What you would own: The geometry reasoning module. Feature extraction from STEP, manufacturability signals, tolerance and surface finish handling. The design agent’s optimisation loop. Iterating a design against a cost or lifecycle target rather than following instructions. Evaluation. Benchmarks, regression suites, and the discipline to drop approaches that do not beat the baseline. Architecture decisions with the founder, including when LLM reasoning beats rules and when it does not. Reasoning Engine and live context retriever Who you probably are: Strong experience with one of those: Python/Rust and C++ and real ML depth. You have built at least once in your life a geometric deep learning, GNNs, 3D representation learning modules in real production data settings and they're used by real users right now. You have touched mechanical engineering for real. A degree, CAE/CAD/CAM work, manufacturing process knowledge, or a PhD near feature recognition, DFM or process simulation. You know why a tight tolerance on one face costs more than a loose one on five. Comfortable with messy industrial data. Re-exported CAD that parses differently, BOMs with missing fields, 40 parts rather than 40,000. You ship. Two-week demoable checkpoints rather than six-month research tracks. Familiar with sustainability concepts and how do they be applied in the context of design and manufacturing Nice to have: OpenCascade, PythonOCC, or commercial CAD kernel experience. MCP servers, agent tooling, or LLM-in-the-loop CAD work. Co-founder-level equity with standard vesting. You would be the thrid engineer in the room, which means you own things outright, including the parts nobody enjoys. We plan to open source what the community builds and put a private product layer on top. To apply, use the button on this page with: 1- How you would pull manufacturing features out of a STEP file you have never seen, and what you would do when it fails. 2- Tell us what do you think the biggest challenges in automating the process of "improving machine and hardware designs and how would you approach solving those challenges" 3- CV 4- What do you do when you are mad or stressed/overworked ? jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
jobs.description: <h3>About Tensordyne&nbsp;</h3> <p>AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>You’ll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.</p> <p>Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.</p> <p>We’re looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You’ll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you’ll partner with them where precision and speed meet.</p> <h3>What you’ll do</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build the stack.</strong> Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.</li> <li><strong>Make models fast.</strong> Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.</li> <li><strong>Close the gap between model and measurement.</strong> Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.</li> <li><strong>Build the agentic performance loop.</strong> Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.</li> <li><strong>Set the bar for performance.</strong> Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.</li> <li><strong>Build for the next chip.</strong> Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.</li> </ul> &

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager - Care Providers & Health
jobs.description: Finance Deserves Better Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, site or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled. Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one: Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one. Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting. Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter. Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée. Now we’re taking Light into specific industries, with the ambition of becoming the operating layer each one runs on. Care homes and clinics sit among our priority sectors. The Role We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to go deep on health, starting with groups that run several care homes, clinics or practices, and work out how Light wins there. These groups carry the finance problems of any multi-entity business, plus funding models, regulation and workflows of their own. Your job is to understand these buyers better than anyone at Light, turn what you learn into positioning and proof our sales team can use, and build the playbook we follow to scale our go-to-market across the sector. You’ll sit in our product marketing team and work side by side with our Care and Health Sales Managers, with support from demand generation, field marketing and product. What You’ll Be Doing Interviewing customers, prospects and specialist partners to learn how care home groups and clinics buy, what makes them change and where their finance workflows break. Mapping the market with Sales: which segments we go after first, which we test, and which we leave for later. Turning what you learn into positioning, messaging and competitive arguments that hold up in front of an operator or a finance director. Building the sales kit, from customer stories and demo narratives to objection handling and one-pagers, so our reps speak the sector’s language. Training sales reps and SDRs on the buyers, workflows and vocabulary of each segment, and joining customer calls to hear what lands. Bringing the sector’s requirements back to Product, and separating the needs that recur from the one-off requests. Giving demand generation and field marketing the insight, content and angles they need for sector campaigns and events, and tracking what turns into pipeline. Writing down what works, so the next sector we enter starts from a playbook rather than a blank page. What We Think* You’ll Need Product marketing experience at a B2B SaaS company, with a track record of taking a product or segment from insight to launch to sales adoption. A habit of talking to customers, and the judgement to turn interviews into clear positioning. Experience in health, care or a closely related sector helps. Curiosity and the speed to earn credibility with operators matter more. Strong writing, from a sharp one-pager to a customer story people want to share. Comfort working with Sales every day, and a feel for what helps a rep win a deal. An analytical streak. You can read funnel data, spot where deals stall and test why. Daily use of AI for research, writing and analysis, with the discipline to check what it tells you. A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please. *If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person. The Good Stuff 🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London. 💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options. 🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Better Collective Sports media at scale, running on data Better Collective is a global sports media group, reaching more than 400 million monthly visits across a portfolio of leading sports media brands. We build products and experiences that make sports more engaging and accessible for fans around the world. Behind that sits a large and diverse technology and data landscape, spanning markets, brands and business models. We work in a collaborative environment where people are encouraged to challenge how things are done, take ownership and help shape what comes next. The domain Paid media is where the data has to pay off. We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut, which markets get more budget: those calls come out of the models this team builds. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, CRM data, all stitched into one user-level view of what a click was actually worth. That model exists and it works. It is also the most demanding domain on our data platform - the most sources, the fastest schema churn, and the shortest patience for a table that landed late. We are looking for the engineer who owns it. Where this role sits A central platform team sets the how. You set the what. Better Collective runs a hub and spoke data organisation. A central data platform team owns the platform itself - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the golden paths, the standards, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a domain team, a spoke, that builds on it. The split is deliberate and we hold to it. The platform team decides how data is produced here. You decide what paid media produces, and you own everything we run. So you are not starting a new stack, and you are not going to spend your year on plumbing that a central team should be solving once for everyone. You are, however, expected to be a demanding customer. When a golden path does not fit paid media, we want you to say so and push for it to change, not quietly build around it. You will report to the Senior Head of Paid Media Insights and work across Paid Media, with the Campaign, Commercial and CRM teams, as well as with the central platform team. What you will own Every data job in paid media. All of it. Freshness, cost, reliability, alerting, and the incident at 07:30 before the spend review. If a paid media model is wrong or late, it is yours, not the platform team's. That accountability is the core of this role, not a footnote to it. Concretely, you will own: The end-to-end user-level model. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, and CRM, joined into one view the business trusts enough to move budget on. Ingestion of paid media sources, built on the platform's framework. Which sources, which schemas, and what happens the next time a network changes its API without telling anyone. The domain's models, from staging through to the marts analysts and business teams actually query, plus the semantic meaning that sits on top of them. Nobody at the centre can define what a qualified signup means in paid media. You can. Reverse ETL back into the ad platforms, so online and offline conversion data lands where it changes bidding. The handover. Part of your first year is taking over the paid media jobs the central team still runs on our behalf, and moving that ownership to where the context actually lives. What you will lead A group of engineers, and the standard they build to You will guide and mentor a group of data engineers in Paid Media Insights, as their technical lead. That means setting the standard for how this domain builds, reviewing their work, unblocking them, and deliberately growing them: giving away the interesting problems rather than keeping them. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. Embedded payments at this depth is rare among European SaaS companies, so the problems here are ones few engineers get to work on.</p> <p>You will be a Staff Engineer in the Payment Interfaces team, part of the Fintech tribe. You will report to the Director of Product and Engineering, sit in the tribe’s leadership group, and work alongside product builders, other staff engineers and product managers. No one reports to you, so your influence comes from the architecture, tools and standards that other people choose to work in.</p> <p>The team integrates several PSPs depending on region and conditions. jobs.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France. Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals). You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers. At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method . This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base. What does make this role exciting : You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating! The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market! ⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1 Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série , avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production. Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes. Missions principales Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage. À ce titre, vous : Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration. Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles , en appliquant les précautions et méthodes

Dans le détail, les missions : Participer au chiffrage de nouveaux projets avec l’équipe commerciale, Planifier, coordonner et suivre des projets de développement de logiciels pilotant un dispositif, Définir le contour, les exigences et les spécifications techniques du projet en relation avec les partenaires concernés (client directement et/ou chef de projet interne du produit), Organiser le travail d’une équipe technique logiciel dans le respect des plannings et du budget, selon les spécifications requises par le client, Être l’interface privilégiée des clients sur le ou les projets pris en charge pour les sujets logiciels, Contribuer à la structuration documentaire des projets (cahiers des charges, architecture, spécifications, rapports, etc.), Assurer la coordination avec le reste de l’équipe R&D et le client, Participer à la réalisation des développements (architecture, codage en appoint des développeurs) Spécifier, concevoir et réaliser les tests, Participer à la gestion des fournisseurs et sous-traitants impliqués dans les projets Veiller au respect des réglementations en vigueur (IEC 62304) avec le support de l’équipe qualité/réglementaire. ♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ? Tu es ingénieur.e de formation ou équivalent, et tu disposes d’une expérience réussie (environ 10 ans) dans la gestion de projets techniques , idéalement dans un environnement réglementé ou dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux . Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension des systèmes pluridisciplinaires (robotique, mécatronique, automatisme) et tu maîtrises les méthodologies de développement logiciel ainsi que les approches Agile. Tu es également à l’aise avec les outils DevOps et tu maîtrises le développement en C# ou en C++ . Tu sais piloter un projet de bout en bout (planning, budget, jalons, reporting), coordonner des équipes aux expertises variées et arbitrer les sujets complexes avec pragmatisme. Une connaissance des normes applicables aux dispositifs médicaux (IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 13485, ISO 14971) est un véritable plus. Au-delà de tes compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité . Curieux.se et passionné.e par la technologie, tu aimes innover et relever des défis. Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et d’autonomie, tout en appréciant le travail collectif. Ton sens de l’écoute, tes qualités de communication et ton orientation client te permettent de créer des relations de confiance et de faire avancer les projets dans un esprit de collaboration. Enfin, tu es à l’aise en anglais, aussi bien à l’écrit qu’à l’oral.
